threads.body: [General] This guard reads the process-global `SemconvStability` value instead of the `v3_preview` value obtained from the `OpenTelemetry` passed to this constructor (line 95). Library callers can supply an `ExtendedOpenTelemetry` without installing it globally, so declarative v3 preview still accepts these removed logging aliases. Pass the constructor's `v3Preview` value into `getConfig` and use it here.

threads.body: [General] `SemconvStability.v3Preview()` is resolved from `GlobalOpenTelemetry`, while this method resolves the alias from its `openTelemetry` argument. For library JDBC usage, a declarative `common.v3_preview: true` on the supplied `ExtendedOpenTelemetry` is therefore ignored unless that instance is also global, and the deprecated `database` alias remains active. Resolve `v3_preview` from `commonConfig`, falling back to the global value only when absent.

threads.body: [General] The deprecated keys are read from the supplied `OpenTelemetry`, but this v3-preview check is resolved from `GlobalOpenTelemetry`. When library autoconfiguration uses a non-global `ExtendedOpenTelemetry` with declarative `common.v3_preview: true`, these aliases are still honored. Resolve the flag from the same common configuration object and pass it into this helper.
